properties.name: Sukkur Barrage
properties.story: A lower-Indus control point where barrages, canals, drains, embankments, roads, and flat terrain turned extreme rainfall and upstream flow into a system-wide drainage crisis.

properties.name: Manchar Lake
properties.story: Normally 250 km²; expanded to 520 km² in Aug 2022. Embankment deliberately breached Sep 5.

properties.name: Dadu, Sindh
properties.story: Entire towns submerged for over 60 days. Among the worst-hit districts.

properties.name: Shisper Glacier (GLOF site)
properties.story: Outburst flood May 7 2022 destroyed Hassanabad Bridge — climate damage hitting 3 months before the Sindh floods.

properties.name: Jacobabad, Sindh
properties.story: Hit 51 °C in June 2022 — one of the hottest places on Earth. Pre-monsoon heat amplified glacial melt.

properties.name: Hassanabad Bridge (collapsed)
properties.story: Historic Karakoram Highway bridge destroyed by Shisper GLOF — the iconic visual of climate-driven cryosphere risk.

properties.name: Indus Delta
properties.story: Pakistan's largest mangrove forest (600,000 ha). 2022 floods delivered a rare freshwater pulse to the dam-starved delta.
